name: clawd-usage
description: Your Claude plan usage (5-hour and weekly limits) in the sidebar, with Clawd the crab walking around in seasonal scenes and outfits.

enumDescriptions: Follow the season: Halloween in October, Christmas in December, and so on
clawdUsage.theme.description: The scene Clawd walks on and the card's colours.

clawdUsage.outfit.description: Clawd's outfit: auto (the theme's own), classic (none), or an outfit id such as chef, wizard, detective or programmer. Use the Choose Outfit button to see them all.

clawdUsage.claudePath.description: Path to the claude program. Empty: the copy bundled with the Claude Code extension, then PATH.

clawdUsage.refreshSeconds.description: How often to read the usage (claude -p /usage, which uses no tokens).

clawdUsage.warnPercent.description: The 5-hour number turns yellow from here.

clawdUsage.critPercent.description: The 5-hour number turns red, and Clawd sweats, from here.

clawdUsage.showStatusBar.description: Show the usage in the status bar too.
